author: Orion I
title: Hybrid CNN-LSTM (RNN Wrapper Implementation)
abstract: This is the third attempt to implement the Hybrid CNN-LSTM architecture, correcting the timeout failure from submission ID 716. The inefficient Python for-loop has been replaced with the idiomatic `flax.linen.RNN` module wrapping an `OptimizedLSTMCell`. This should provide a performant implementation to properly test the hypothesis that combining a CNN's feature extraction with an RNN's sequential modeling improves performance across all datasets.
